Case study
Lena's intro calls, kept in check
Lena runs 30-minute intro calls from Berlin and wants gaps, warning and a cap. Follow three settings from the Limits & buffers tab to the times Clara can book.
Limits & buffers
Keep 15 minutes free after each call
Lena sets After event to 15 minutes. Bookers can no longer pick a time that starts within 15 minutes of a call ending, or ends within 15 minutes of the next one.
Limits & buffers
No bookings at the last minute
She raises Minimum notice from 2 to 4 hours. At 09:40, the first time anyone can book today is 14:00.
Limits & buffers
Two intro calls a day, at most
She turns on Limit booking frequency and sets 2 per day. Once a day holds two intro calls, the booking page treats it as full.
Booking page
Clara sees only the times that fit
Thursday already has Martin and Pieter, so it's greyed out. On Friday, 10:30 and 11:30 are gone because they'd touch Reilly's 11:00 call and its buffer. Clara picks 12:00.
Calendar
Two days with room to breathe
Clara's call lands half an hour after Reilly's, the 15 minutes after it stay free, and Thursday stops at two calls.

Questions about buffers and limits
What each setting on the Limits & buffers tab does to your booking page.
Ask a question
What are buffer times?
Time kept free before or after each booking of the event, up to 120 minutes. Bookers can't pick a time whose buffer would run into another booking or an event on your connected calendar.
How does minimum notice work?
It hides every time that starts sooner than the notice from now. New event types start at 2 hours, and you can set it in minutes, hours or days.
What does Limit booking frequency count?
Bookings of this event type per day, week, month or year, and you can set more than one. Once a period reaches its number, the booking page offers no more times in it.
How is Limit total booking duration different?
It adds up minutes instead of counting bookings, such as 120 minutes per week. When one more booking would take a period past the limit, that period stops offering times.
Can I stop people booking months ahead?
Yes. Limit future bookings sets a rolling window, such as 30 business or calendar days into the future, or a fixed date range.
What do time-slot intervals and the first-slot option change?
Time-slot intervals set how far apart start times are, and by default they follow the event's length. Show only the first available slot each day offers one time per day, the earliest free one.
